Class HappyHour

java.lang.Object
control.HappyHour
public class HappyHour extends Object
Tracks the game's one Happy Hour: whether it has been used, when it started, and how many turns it has left. Happy Hour can be started once per game and lasts for the turn it starts plus the turns after it, up to its duration.

This class only handles timing. The discount comes from PricingPolicy, and the satisfaction recovery is applied by GameController.

Author:
CT2003 Group 3
